bullets.text: Anbumani Ramadoss claimed that constructing a boundary wall in the Pallikaranai marshland in Chennai will cause a major disaster.
A young man tragically died from toxic gas inhalation while cleaning a septic tank in Pallikaranai, Chennai, causing local grief.
The State Wetlands Authority informed the Madras High Court that the interim zone of influence around Pallikaranai can be restricted to 36 survey numbers.
The government informed the Madras High Court that 128.19 hectares across 36 survey numbers have been identified as the interim impact zone for the Pallikaranai marshland.
News channels questioned whether the boundary wall and pathways in the Pallikaranai marshland constitute a recovery or destruction project.
Residents in Poonamallee faced distress due to continuous power outages occurring during the night.
MGNREGA workers staged a protest and besieged the BDO office in Tiruttani after being paid low wages.
A younger brother stabbed and killed his older brother in Ambattur following an alleged dispute over molestation involving a niece.
Amid rising public complaints of power outages, Tamil Nadu has started procuring electricity from private suppliers to bridge shortages.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay urged Prime Minister Narendra Modi to ensure early approval for Chennai Metro Rail Phase-III.
Tamil Nadu start-ups pitched their ideas to Prime Minister Narendra Modi during an inaugural Chennai Metro Rail ride.
PMK leader Anbumani Ramadoss angrily criticized that TVK is continuing what DMK did regarding Pallikaranai and warned they will not stay silent.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay is scheduled to travel to Andhra Pradesh to meet Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu regarding Krishna river water sharing.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay jointly inaugurated a stretch of Chennai Metro Phase II and rode the train together.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani stretch of Chennai Metro Phase 2, which will improve western connectivity.
